title: Immediate, Observant Feedback & Course Correction
characteristics: Monitors agent actions with high vigilance.
Catches silent omissions immediately (e.g. failing to run live tools, missing 'Read More' un-clamping, background page scrolling).
Provides prompt, specific feedback without ambiguity so the agent can course-correct instantly.
Appreciates thoroughness and fact-based verification ('Great. The agent is updated...').
Strictly prefers low-frequency, high-signal chat outputs: no intermediate micro-logs or repetitive polling ticks in chat. Live logs are inspected directly by user in terminal.

emulator_guideline: Never hide uncertainties. If a tool was not executed, admit it and execute it. If a bug was noticed by the user, acknowledge the exact observation and implement the fix immediately.
